lists.content:
Prefr (operated by CreditVidya) is a digital-first lending platform that makes credit accessible to millions across India. with loan offerings ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh, we’re enabling instant personal loans and flexible pay-later credit lines, especially for first-time borrowers and underserved regions. backed by RBI-approved NBFC partnerships, we’ve built a platform that uses selfie-based KYC, minimal documentation, and AI-powered underwriting to disburse loans within minutes.

we are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee the accounting, payments, and treasury functions for a fast-growing Fintech company and will lead the AP team, ensuring timely and accurate payments of company liabilities, optimizing the AP process, and working closely with vendors, procurement, and internal stakeholders. the Finance Manager will ensure compliance with statutory requirements (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act) and optimize cash flow management while driving financial process improvements and ensuring the accuracy of financial statements.

What will you do?

  • oversee daily accounting operations, including managing the general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end closing

  • ensure timely and accurate processing of payments (vendor payments, taxes) and adherence to internal control standards

  • establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring effective dispute resolution and favorable terms

  • manage treasury functions, including cash flow management, forecasting, and working capital optimization

  • ensure compliance with statutory regulations, including TDS, GST, MSME Act, and Companies Act, and coordinate with auditors during internal and external audits

  • develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to safeguard company assets

  • prepare and publish AP-related reports (e.g., cash flow forecasting, aging analysis)

  • collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., product team, sales team, collection team, Admin team) to ensure financial alignment with business operations

  • prepare, analyze, and present financial reports to senior management, including cash flow projections and variance analysis

  • lead initiatives to improve financial systems and processes, leveraging automation tools. Optimize the AP workflow through automation, process improvements, and implementation of best practices

  • monitor and manage banking relationships

  • manage vendor onboarding and master vendor data maintenance, ensuring data accuracy

  • manage and mentor a team of AP specialists, providing training and performance feedback

    •  

    You should apply if you are/have:

  • Chartered Accountant with 4-7 years of experience

  • deep understanding of Indian statutory regulations (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act)

  • proven track record of process improvement and automation in AP

  • strong knowledge of treasury management, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization

  • experience in financial reporting, reconciliations, and managing audits

  • good communication and interpersonal skills to articulate and collaborate across departments

• own collection performance for the assigned geography and bucket(s); understand local portfolio characteristics, monitor portfolio movement, and execute collection strategies to drive resolution and recovery outcomes.
  • lead, coach, and develop a team of 2-5 direct reports; set clear expectations, review productivity and performance, and drive the team towards collection targets.
  • manage 3-6 collection agencies across the assigned geography; ensure adequate capacity, drive productivity and resolution outcomes, and maintain adherence to quality and compliance standards.
  • own resolution and recovery targets for the assigned portfolio; analyse MIS and key collection metrics, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve outcomes.
  • ensure adherence to RBI guidelines, company policies, and the code of conduct for collections; proactively identify and address compliance or process gaps.
  • work closely with operations, risk, legal, analytics, and agency management teams to resolve dependencies, improve collection outcomes, and ensure effective execution of collection strategies.

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual compensation range for this role, depending on individual candidate level and experience, is $175,000 - $225,000 including base salary and any related bonuses or commissions. 
In the US, JumpCloud® provides a comprehensive benefits package, with several medical plans to choose from including a high deductible HSA plan with employer contribution, two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), employee assistance program (EAP), short- and long-term disability, life insurance and a 401k savings plan with match. We have a flexible paid time off policy.
 
 
 
#LI-MH1


Where you’ll be working/Location:
JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 
 
All roles posted in United States locations do require that you be located within one of the 50 U.S. States.  Our Headquarters is in the Denver/Boulder, CO area but as a remote company, you are able to work remotely anywhere in the U.S.  If you would like to spend time in our offices in the Denver/Boulder area, you are welcome to do that as well.
 
Language: 
JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 
Why JumpCloud?  
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 
 
Scam Notice:
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced regional sales professional who loves selling to highly technical buyers. This role is responsible for selling our Cloud Directory Platform to our Enterprise segment for New Logo acquisition.  You will act as a strategic advisor to C-level executives, helping them solve critical business challenges through our innovative solutions.
We work in a Product and Sales Led Growth model serving IT professionals and business stakeholders to help them improve the security posture of their organization and to increase the effectiveness of their IT organization.

lists.content:
• Strategic Prospecting: Develop and execute a comprehensive territory plan to identify high-value enterprise opportunities within your assigned territory.

  • Full Sales Cycle Management: Lead the entire sales process from initial discovery and technical validation to negotiation and final contract execution.

  • C-Suite Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leadership and key stakeholders across multiple departments (IT, Finance, Operations, etc.).

  • Value-Based Selling: Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations that articulate the ROI and strategic value of our platform tailored to specific enterprise needs.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Solution Engineers and Product teams to ensure technical alignment and a seamless transition for new clients.

  • Forecasting & Reporting: Maintain high CRM hygiene and provide accurate weekly/monthly sales forecasts to leadership.

  • Negotiate and close new business with our Enterprise segment of +2000 employees and larger.

• Quota Attainment

  • Outbound Pipeline Generation

  • Opportunity Close Rate

  • Quarterly Recurring Revenue

• Expertise in MEDDICC, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or similar enterprise sales methodologies.

  • Coachable and able to implement feedback given 

  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and verbal/written communication skills.

  • 7+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 3-5 years specifically in Enterprise SaaS.

  • Proven history of consistently over-achieving seven-figure annual quotas and managing 6-12 month sales cycles.

  • Exceptional track record of targeting and closing deals with Enterprise Customers.
